notes.title: Big Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Legendary items, Loot text, new enchants, visual upgrades, bug fixes and more!

This update brings up a ton of changes and new additions to the game. 

I will highlight some of these in detail. The full list of changes will be at the bottom of this post.


[h1][b]Legendary Items[/b][/h1]

[img]http://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27458697/696b869bfeb0783c3da58b6d120c7c1d2bf7f501.png[/img]

Over 30 new Legendary Items have been introduced to the game. Each one of them with unique name/skin and powerful effects. 

Legendaries have better stats than normal items, more damage/armor/stats. And don't have level, instead they level up automatically when you do. This way Legendary items are always useful even if it dropped early in the game.

They can be enchanted but not recicled.

Bosses drop a guaranteed random Legendary. And normal enemies have a chance to drop one as well.


[h1][b]Loot Text[/b][/h1]

[img]http://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27458697/c58994b71ef63a8a681c3988ae93b01a27405a0d.png[/img]

A new feature that displays the item names inside drop bags.

Uses different colors for each type of item. Blue for Potions, Green for Ingredients, Orange for Weapon/Armor and Purple for Legendary.

This feature is enabled by default. It can be toogled on/off by pressing [b][ALT][/b] key.

Also it can display item information by mouse over the text and pressing [b][CONTROL][/b] key.

Left-Click on any Loot Text to pick up the item (stay close).


[h1][b]Life Bars[/b][/h1]

[img]http://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27458697/7046a6cb3971d7cf7ef37f6947e49c777bbe5e34.png[/img]

Another new feature for displaying how much life an enemy has.

This option can be enabled/disabled in game options menu.

Note that in this patch, enemies regenerate life when disengage out of combat.


[h1][b]Crafting[/b][/h1]

[img]http://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27458697/c43522ab44ff11196c268c954e6c426b5f92246c.png[/img]

This quality of life change makes crafting more easy, because no longer is required to find an Alchemy table on the map. 

Instead, just open the Character panel and click the "Anvil" icon. It will open the Crafting panel.

Note that has some limitation, it cannot be used while in a Boss fight.


[h1][b]Developer Notes[/b][/h1]

I'm sorry for not updating the game in a long time. As a solo developer I don't have the time or resources I need to make faster changes/testing or creating new content.

Nevertheless, I will continue to working and releasing small patches/hotfixes more regularly.

This patch is the result of months of work. It was planned to be deployed with the new DLC I'm working on, but the progress is going slow, so I decided to make a patch with all the finished changes.

I'm happy to make it a better game.

Have fun!


[h1][b]Changelog 1.3.0[/b][/h1]

[list][*] 30+ Legendary items with unique and powerful effects
[*] Legendary items level up with you automatically
[*] Normal enemies have a chance to drop legendary items
[*] Bosses drop a guaranteed legendary item
[*] Bosses are now immune to Fear and Petrified effects	
[*] Enemies regenerate life when disengage out of combat
[*] New enchants for weapons and armor
[*] Added the option to display enemies Life Bar (Game Options)
[*] Hard and Hero difficulties now reduces player resistances	
[*] Wisdom Trials rewards you with a Legendary chest for each completed level
[*] Wisdom Trials Legendary chests have one random legendary item and useful potions
[*] Crafting is now accesible anywhere using a button in the Character panel
[*] Crafting is not available during boss fights
[*] New archivement for completing Wisdom Trials in Hero difficulty
[*] Added bullet trails to Arrows
[*] Increased projectile speed to all Arrows
[*] Map panel scales to fit the interface properly
[*] Chests with items inside have sparkles as indicator
[*] Legendary items always show up first in the inventory
[*] Loot drops have a text display with the name of the item
[*] Loot Text can be toggled on/off with [Alt] key
[*] Pressing [Control] key while mouseover any Loot Text shows the item info
[*] [Left Click] on any Loot Text will pick up that item
[*] Desintegrate animations are now slightly faster
[*] Desintegrate animations don't interrupt other effects like [Elemental Explosion] talent
[*] Reduced enemy density on Earth maps
[*] Reduced enemy density on the second level of Wisdom Trials
[*] Poison/Thorn Bulb enemies no longer drop items when killed
[*] [Strong Arm Bow] now has 10% ignore armor
[*] [Potion of Absorption] shield bonus reduced from 50% to 35%, and duration from 60s to 30s
[*] [Hawkeye] talent damage bonus reduced from 50% to 30%
[*] Bleed Effect now causes ABSOLUTE damage (ignores armor and resistances)	
[*] Improved Bleed animation
[*] Improved "Energy Shield" animations
[*] Improved enemy Beholder animation
[*] Improved loading screen visuals
[*] Improved Poison/Thorn Bulb enemy texture and animations
[*] Improved Status text visibility (Burn, Stun, Poison, Frozen, Bleed)
[*] Improved many interface visuals
[*] Improved enemy collisions
[*] Improved many object textures
[*] Improved light map rendering (~50% faster!!)
[*] Improved shaders performance
[*] Improved perfomance and stability on many maps
[*] Fixed main menu camera going outside map bounds
[*] Fixed player stuck relocation on some maps
[*] Fixed talent [Secret Recipe] not displaying the time increase
[*] Fixed items enchanted with [Elementium] removing more than one enchant slot
[*] Fixed picking up items with [Space] key displaying multiple notifications
[*] Fixed some objects cannot interact because "Too far away" message
[*] Fixed many bugs and text corrections
[/list]


Game Guide: [url=http://www.uroborostudio.com/guide]http://www.uroborostudio.com/guide[/url]

notes.title: Wisdom Trials Guide
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27458697/09f4d0c3b0659d4352877c16062d2d4ee8404ca0.png[/img]

While I'm working on the next content update, I had some spare time to make a guide for the Wisdom Trials DLC.

[url=http://www.uroborostudio.com/guide/#wisdom]http://www.uroborostudio.com/guide/#wisdom[/url]

I'm sure this guide will help anyone who has been stuck solving this difficult puzzles.

The guide itself does't provide a direct solution to the puzzles. But instead it tells you how to solve them because each new game the solutions are different.

I'm sure it will be helpful.

The development of the new game mode is going slowly but steadily. It's too early to show any screenshots but I will share some information about.

- New game mode with infinite levels
- Each level is procedurally generated
- Enemies no longer drop items, but gold instead
- Gold can be used to buy items in the store
- Player starts with 3 lifes, if looses all cannot continue
- Some levels has puzzles that must be solved to continue

I will post more info and screenshots as the development goes on.

Happy Summer!! 


Game Development Blog
[url=http://www.uroborostudio.com/blog]http://www.uroborostudio.com/blog[/url]

notes.title: Spring Sale + Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
This big update contains many improvements and fixes. Also includes the new Wisdom Trials DLC for everyone. And to celebrate it, the game and the soundtrack will be on sale for the rest of the month! Enjoy!

You can start a Wisdom Trials game by going [Main Menu -> New Game] and select the game mode (Story or DLC), then select a difficulty setting and an empty slot to save the game.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Wisdom Trials DLC
[list]
[*] 2 hours of gameplay
[*] 6 new maps and new boss
[*] Challenging logic puzzles
[/list]	[/list]
[list]
[*] Parallax backgrounds (no more boring black)
[*] Player directional mouse animations (attack, movement)
[*] Lime enemies now drop a slowing goo on death
[*] Sparkles animation on doors with map transition
[*] Improved shaders quality and performance
[*] Improved pathfinding algorithm
[*] Improved many projectile textures
[*] Fixed bonus damage stacking with [Bloodlust] and [Spell Strike] talents
[*] Fixed a bug with archer enemies doing no damage
[/list]

notes.title: Info - Wisdom Trials DLC
notes.notes:
This DLC will be released 14th April, in about two weeks. It will be free and available for everyone.

Adds a new game mode (independant from "Story Mode") with 6 news maps focused on puzzle interaction and solving. 

It will have a new Boss fight at the end of the Trials, if you pass them all.

The puzzles will be the most difficult in the game yet. They are challenging but not impossible.

Also, the DLC will come along with a game update with a few visual and technical improvements. 


Will you pass the Wisdom Trials? 
Find out 14th April.

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.notes:
During the game development, many puzzles were cut off due to beign too hard and complex and never passed the concept phase.

Nevertheless, some of this puzzle concepts are really interesting and clever. So I decided to re-design them and make a full puzzle maps. They will be hard but not impossible.

Maybe even add a few new items like weapons/potions/arrows.

It will be released as a [b]FREE DLC[/b] for everyone early-mid April.

I will post more information in a couple of weeks.

Thank you all.

notes.title: Update 1.1.3 + Russian Language
notes.notes:
I'm glad to announce that the game have been fully translated to russian. This patch includes the new files along with a couple of fixes.

The language can be changed in [Main Menu] -> [Options] -> [Language]

And regarding game balance, enemies die too fast at higher levels. So I've added a progressive armor values that scales with the enemy level. The enemy level is the same as the player, except for bosses.

And sorry for not reply all the comment/questions. My personal life is a bit messy right now.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Russian language added
[*]Enemies gain 1.5 plus armor each level, for a total of +30 at level 20
[*]Fixed rare bug: enemies attack at higher speed than normal
[/list]

Game Guide [url=http://www.uroborostudio.com/guide/]http://www.uroborostudio.com/guide[/url]

notes.title: Big Update 02-16-2017
notes.notes:
This is a big update with many fixes and improvements.

The most important change is the engine library update to use SFML 2.4.2 that solves most of the graphical bugs and random crashes (specially with Intel HD cards).

Also, I added a new option in the Video menu for disabling the use of shaders. They are not very complex but I'm aware of some issues with old video cards. So if you are having problems even with this update, try disabling this option.

For the rest, a few improvements in animations and particles. And some other fixes for a better performance.

Thanks all for the feedback.

[h1]Changelog 1.1.0[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated engine SFML library to 2.4.2 version
[*]Updated Options menu interface
[*]Added a 'Shaders' option in Video Menu for enable/disable
[*]Frozen animation improved
[*]Poison animation and poison weapons improved
[*]Level 4 spells cooldown increased to 100 seconds
[*]Improved overall performance
[*]Fixed a bug where Bat enemies could hit multiple times in one attack
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash whith certain animations

notes.title: Big Update 02-16-2017
notes.notes:
This is a big update with many fixes and improvements.

The most important change is the engine library update to use SFML 2.4.2 that solves most of the graphical bugs and random crashes (specially with Intel HD cards).

Also, I added a new option in the Video menu for disabling the use of shaders. They are not very complex but I'm aware of some issues with old video cards. So if you are having problems even with this update, try disabling this option.

For the rest, a few improvements in animations and particles. And some other fixes for a better performance.

Thanks all for the feedback.

It contains spoilers, so use it at your own discretion.
